product.description: Indio™ by Monoprice™Power Block Fully Isolated 8‑output Guitar Pedal Power SupplyThe Pedalboard Power Supply for Up to 8 Guitar and Bass Effects Pedals.Get the most out of your pedalboard with the Indio™ by Monoprice™ Power Block. A universal power supply for battery‑operated guitar and bass effect pedals that features eight completely isolated outputs. This eliminates the possibility of experiencing ground oriented hum or noise issues between the pedals in your "stage rig". Each output is optimized to handle a wide range of pedal types with six fixed voltage outputs and 2 variable outputs.
